SkyGarden_Text_Npc0.en: The gardener flies. I do not ask\nhow.
SkyGarden_Text_Npc0.fr: Le jardinier vole. Je ne demande\npas comment.

SkyGarden_Text_Npc1.en: The best view in the region. Do not\ntell.
SkyGarden_Text_Npc1.fr: La meilleure vue de la région. Ne\nle dis pas.

SkyGarden_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

SkyGarden_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
